stories.title: OpenAI sues Apple, claims iPhone maker rehired ex-worker to steal its secret AI device plans
stories.summary: OpenAI has filed a lawsuit against Apple, alleging that Apple rehired a former OpenAI employee with the intention of acquiring confidential plans for an AI device. This legal action suggests a dispute over intellectual property and competitive practices in the AI technology sector.

stories.title: Palantir signs $300 million deal with Poland to bring AI to military operations
stories.summary: Palantir has secured a $300 million agreement with Poland to integrate artificial intelligence into the country's military operations. This deal signifies a significant step in enhancing military capabilities through advanced technology and highlights the growing role of AI in national defense.

stories.title: Less than a week after Jensen Huang joining back as CEO, Nvidia sends message to manufacturing partners; strict instruction says: Stop shipping server chips to these four countries
stories.summary: Less than a week after Jensen Huang's return as CEO, Nvidia has instructed its manufacturing partners to cease shipping server chips to four specific countries. This directive indicates a significant shift in Nvidia's distribution strategy or compliance policies under its renewed leadership.

stories.title: Instagram Is Coming To Your Television, You Can Now Watch Reels With Family And Friends
stories.summary: Instagram is now available on televisions in India, allowing users to view Reels, Stories, and content from creators on larger screens. This expansion provides a new way for people to experience Instagram content with others in a living room setting.

stories.title: Motorola Signature 27 India Launch Date Confirmed: Check Expected Price, Specifications
stories.summary: The Motorola Signature 27 is set to launch in India on December 9, 2026. This upcoming device is expected to feature a Snapdragon processor, a 200MP periscope camera, and a 7,000mAh battery, indicating a focus on high-end specifications.

stories.title: Federal regulators shut $6 billion Indiana lender in biggest bank failure in over two years
stories.summary: Federal regulators have closed a $6 billion lender in Indiana, marking the largest bank failure in over two years. This event indicates a significant development in the financial sector.

stories.title: Adani Group Seeks Government Nod To Invest In India's Airline Sector
stories.summary: The Adani Group is seeking government approval to invest in India's airline sector. This move is driven by an increase in air travel demand and the need for more flights.

stories.title: OpenAI Accuses Apple Of Pressuring Suppliers And Restricting Employee Mobility
stories.summary: OpenAI has accused Apple of pressuring its suppliers, limiting employee movement, and misusing trade secrets. These accusations are part of an escalating legal dispute between the two companies regarding hardware ambitions.

stories.title: Festive & wedding season demand may push India's retail inflation higher, warns govt
stories.summary: India's retail inflation is expected to rise in the coming months due to increased demand during the festive and wedding seasons. The government is concerned about the prices of food and non-food items, as well as potential impacts from geopolitical tensions and oil price fluctuations. Despite these risks, the economy is supported by strong domestic demand and improvements in manufacturing.

stories.title: A.I. Companies Race for Space in New York, a City That Doesn’t Have Much of It
stories.summary: The artificial intelligence industry is driving a significant increase in demand for office space in Manhattan, potentially making it the strongest year for the market since 2000. As available space becomes scarce, AI companies are finding innovative ways to secure real estate.

stories.title: Delimitation Explained: How Constituencies Are Redrawn, Who Decides And What The New Bill Says
stories.summary: The headline reports on the process of delimitation, which involves redrawing electoral constituencies. It also explains who is responsible for these decisions and what a new bill proposes regarding this process.

stories.title: Millions of Children Are Losing Food Stamps
stories.summary: Millions of children are losing food stamp benefits due to recent policy changes. Republicans stated these cuts were intended to combat fraud and encourage adults to enter the workforce, but the result has been a significant reduction in aid for children.

stories.title: MSF ‘outraged’ as two workers killed in Israeli strike on Gaza
stories.summary: Doctors Without Borders expressed strong disapproval after two of its workers were killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza.

stories.title: Trump’s Embrace of Xi and Huang Stuns China Critics in Washington
stories.summary: Some China critics in Washington are surprised by Trump's positive remarks about Xi and Huang. These critics have become more vocal, particularly concerning the competition for dominance in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Supreme Court raps TVK government, orders lamp lit at Tamil Nadu site today
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has criticized the TVK government and issued an order for a lamp to be lit at a site in Tamil Nadu today.

stories.title: IBM halts H-1B, green card support; asks Indian staff to move to India or resign
stories.summary: IBM has stopped sponsoring H-1B visas and green cards for its employees. Indian staff have been given the option to either relocate to India or leave the company.

stories.title: Barnard College resumes CPT approvals for international students after US court blocks stricter work authorisation rules
stories.summary: Barnard College has restarted approving CPT applications for its international students. This decision follows a US court's action to block stricter regulations regarding work authorization.

stories.title: Infosys sees eightfold jump in US H-1B approvals to 2,088 in FY26 as Texas plans to lift hiring curbs: Rep
stories.summary: Infosys is projected to see a significant increase in its H-1B visa approvals, reaching 2,088 in fiscal year 2026. This surge is anticipated as Texas plans to remove restrictions on hiring.

stories.title: Thousands of international students in Connecticut could face new work hurdles under Trump proposal
stories.summary: A new proposal from the Trump administration could create difficulties for thousands of international students in Connecticut seeking work opportunities. The potential changes might introduce new obstacles to their employment.

stories.title: Mississippi Senator-elect Scott Colom calls for H-1B visa reforms, says Americans should get priority for tech jobs | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Mississippi Senator-elect Scott Colom is advocating for changes to the H-1B visa program. He believes that American citizens should be given preference for technology sector jobs.
